[NDBG.9.3.2] **Disconnect and restart.** The engine is the adapter's
own ([NDBG.9.1.2]), so `disconnect` must end the session: the adapter frees
the engine and every timeline, and exits.

`restart` must re-read the program, the trace and the fact files, compiling a
`.ds` program again, and start the session over. Breakpoints are kept and
verified again. Every fork is dropped ([NDBG.14.17]).
